description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for accessing and manipulating news resource data in a database, including methods for querying, inserting, updating, and deleting news resources and related cross-reference data.

methods.name: getNewsResources
methods.description: Fetches news resources matching optional filter criteria, returning a Flow of a list of PopulatedNewsResource objects.

methods.name: getNewsResourceIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of news resources matching optional filter criteria, returning a Flow of a list of Strings.

methods.name: upsertNewsResources
methods.description: Inserts or updates a list of NewsResourceEntity objects in the database.

methods.name: insertOrIgnoreTopicCrossRefEntities
methods.description: Inserts a list of NewsResourceTopicCrossRef objects, ignoring conflicts.

methods.name: deleteNewsResources
methods.description: Deletes news resources from the database matching the provided list of IDs.
